what_it_does: Presents a thin C++ wrapper layer that allows CUDA code (written for NVIDIA GPUs) to run on SYCL-compatible systems (including Intel GPUs) without requiring extensive code rewriting. Converts CUDA kernel functions to SYCL through an automated 'functorization' process while preserving the original kernel syntax and launch patterns, tested on large-scale scientific applications like N-body cosmology simulations.
